tools.description_excerpt: Navigate to a URL in the browser
tools.name: browser_navigate

tools.description_excerpt: Click an element by index or at specific viewport coordinates. Use index for elements from browser_get_state, or coordinate_x/coordinate_y for pixel-precise clicking.
tools.name: browser_click

tools.description_excerpt: Type text into an input field. Clears existing text by default; pass text="" to clear only.
tools.name: browser_type

tools.description_excerpt: Get the current state of the page including all interactive elements
tools.name: browser_get_state

tools.description_excerpt: Extract structured content from the current page based on a query
tools.name: browser_extract_content

tools.description_excerpt: Get the raw HTML of the current page or a specific element by CSS selector
tools.name: browser_get_html

tools.description_excerpt: Take a screenshot of the current page. Returns viewport metadata as text and the screenshot as an image.
tools.name: browser_screenshot

tools.description_excerpt: Go back to the previous page
tools.name: browser_go_back

tools.description_excerpt: Retry a task using the browser-use agent. Only use this as a last resort if you fail to interact with a page multiple times.
tools.name: retry_with_browser_use_agent

tools.description_excerpt: List all active browser sessions with their details and last activity time
tools.name: browser_list_sessions

tools.description_excerpt: Close a specific browser session by its ID
tools.name: browser_close_session

tools.description_excerpt: Close all active browser sessions and clean up resources
tools.name: browser_close_all
